submission.justification: Absorber-F1 with 4mm plate thickness is recommended as it provides the best energy resolution (3.887% at 100 GeV) among materials that satisfy all constraints. While Absorber-F2 offers slightly better resolution at its optimal thickness, it must be disqualified because its activation level of 85 μSv/h far exceeds the 20 μSv/h limit required for hands-on maintenance during shutdowns. Absorber-F3 meets the maintenance constraint but delivers significantly worse resolution (5.083% at its optimum). F1 at 4mm achieves an excellent balance: it provides superior energy resolution compared to F3, maintains activation at only 12 μSv/h (well within the safety limit with 8 μSv/h margin), and allows for safe hands-on maintenance as required.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: Among valid candidates, F1 at 4mm achieves 3.887% resolution, superior to F3's 5.083%. F2 (3.178%) is disqualified due to maintenance constraints.

requirements.requirement: Absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 is one of the three candidate materials (F1, F2, F3) evaluated in the analysis.

requirements.requirement: Calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns
requirements.evidence: F1 activation level is 12 μSv/h, well below the 20 μSv/h limit. F1_maintenance_allowed = 1 confirms this requirement is satisfied.
Recommended thickness of 4mm is within the specified range of 2-10mm.
